entries.title: Tell us about your experience with your federal representatives
entries.summary: Have you reached out to your congressional representatives in recent months? Tell us how they responded.
entries.content:
We’re reporting on how responsive the offices of our federal lawmakers are towards constituent concerns. We’ve reported that thousands of West Virginians are at risk of losing key food assistance and medical insurance programs in light of the funding bill that passed Congress in early July. West Virginians have told us they have been reaching out to their congressional representatives, and we want to know how that is going.

Are you a West Virginia resident who has reached out to the offices of Sen. Shelley Moore Capito, Sen. Jim Justice, Rep. Riley Moore or Rep. Carol Miller? Did you feel like your concern was adequately addressed? We want to hear from you.
entries.author: Mountain State Spotlight Staff
